liquidity_funding.text: Liquidity rose by {{liquidity.change@FY2024}} to {{liquidity@FY2024}}, of which {{undrawn_facilities@FY2024}} in undrawn committed facilities, and liquidity to revenue reached {{liquidity_to_revenue@FY2024}}.

Debt due within a year rose by {{debt_due_1y.change@FY2024}} to {{debt_due_1y@FY2024}}, but short-term debt cover was stable at {{short_term_debt_cover@FY2024}}, so the near-term maturities are covered by liquidity without new funding.

Free cash flow after lease payments rose by {{fcf_after_leases.change@FY2024}} to {{fcf_after_leases@FY2024}}, lifting FCF after leases to debt by {{fcf_after_leases_to_debt.change@FY2024}} to {{fcf_after_leases_to_debt@FY2024}}, the comparable measure of cash left for debt holders once lease payments in financing cash flows are taken out.

Customer prepayments remain large, with contract liabilities of {{contract_liabilities@FY2024}}, up {{contract_liabilities.change@FY2024}}, and the group replaced its secured revolving credit facility with a new sustainability-linked facility during the year.

watch_items.text: Unit cost: CASK ex-fuel rose by {{cask_ex_fuel.change@FY2024}} to {{cask_ex_fuel@FY2024}}, so non-fuel costs are absorbing part of the revenue gain.
Undrawn facilities: committed undrawn lines fell by {{undrawn_facilities.change@FY2024}} to {{undrawn_facilities@FY2024}}, a thinner buffer alongside the {{liquidity@FY2024}} of liquidity.

Customer prepayments: advance ticket cover of {{advance_ticket_cover@FY2024}} is above the peer median of {{advance_ticket_cover.peer_median@FY2024}} but the weakest of the group ({{advance_ticket_cover.peer_rank@FY2024}}), leaving the cash position sensitive to a slower booking cycle.

Fleet and operations: the average fleet age rose by {{fleet_age.change@FY2024}} to {{fleet_age@FY2024}}, and reliability issues with Rolls-Royce Trent and Pratt and Whitney GTF engines continued to affect operations.
